text:
tayla-marketing: T-minus 48h — final announce checklist. Need ack on: changelog link, docs bundle, webinar CTA copy, inbound lead routing, and canary timing. Who can confirm?

alex-engineering: Changelog pushed: https://internal.redwood/docs/changelog/dedicated-v2-2026-03-25 (small typo fixed in rolling policy). canary planned, details below.

jisoo-product: Docs bundle uploaded to the public docs staging folder. Quick links:
```
Docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/dedicated/v2
Quickstart: https://docs.redwood.ai/dedicated/v2/quickstart
Changelog: https://internal.redwood/docs/changelog/dedicated-v2-2026-03-25
```

samir-sales: For inbound routing — please tag all demo requests with `source:announce_v2` and route to sales-team@redwood.ai. I'll add a webhook mapping in the CRM once we have the final doc URL.

tayla-marketing: Webinar CTA copy (draft): "Join our deep-dive on Dedicated V2 — deployment, cost savings, and benchmarks. Register now." Anyone want to tweak? need final link.

alex-engineering: Canary window: 2026-03-25T10:00:00Z -> 2026-03-25T12:00:00Z in us-west-2. If no errors, ramp to 20% at 12:30Z, 100% by 14:00Z. Ops will monitor latency and error budget.

ops-bot: ALERT: Canary health checks configured. Auto-rollback threshold = 3% 5xx over 5m. Tracing hooks enabled for token-level breakdowns.

jisoo-product: Bench narrative final: 3x throughput improvement at 2k seq, median p95 latency reduced by 27%, cost-per-token down 18% with our new batching profile. Marketing to use short callouts with links to the full benchmark doc.

samir-sales: Confirmed — CRM mapping set to route `announce_v2` leads to the EPD queue, with urgency=true for enterprise matches.

tayla-marketing: Great. Final asks: (1) Engineering confirm changelog URL is safe to share externally (internal link above is currently gated) (2) Product share final docs external URLs (not staging) (3) Ops confirm monitoring contacts and escalation path during rollout.

alex-engineering: I'll flip the changelog to public after legal gives the OK; say EOD today. Ops contacts: @devops-oncall and @platform-sre (both added to the incident rota).

ops-bot: NOTE: On-call rotation: devops-oncall (primary) for first 2h, platform-sre (secondary) after that. Pager duty hooks active.

jisoo-product: Public docs urls ready: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/dedicated-v2 and the benchmark PDF: https://docs.redwood.ai/assets/dedicated-v2-benchmark.pdf

tayla-marketing: Perfect — I'll schedule the announce tweet thread, update the newsroom post with the changelog and docs, and send the webinar invite. Final: anyone object to the planned timing (canary 10Z, announce 15Z same day)?

samir-sales: No objections from sales. Slight ask: delay external announce by 30m if we see any rollbacks during canary.

alex-engineering: Agreed — we'll hold the release switch if rollback triggers. I'll post status in this thread during the canary. :thumbsup:

tayla-marketing: Thanks all — final prep call in 30m in #marketing-ops. Will post the publish checklist here once legal signs off on the changelog. :rocket:
